profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Qualtrics
profile.summary:
Hello! My name is Anthony Tsou, and I am currently a Staff Software Engineer at Qualtrics on the XM Directory team based in Seattle, WA. 

I graduated with a Bachelors in Computer Science from the Georgia Institute of Technology on December 2016.

positions.title: Strategic Solutions Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Upgraded data migration tools to support dynamic data parsing, custom fields, and additional integration with Zuora API, increasing usability and stability
- Communicated with clients regarding troubleshooting, demoing, and improving data migration tools

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
- Teaching assistant for CS 4400, Introduction to Database Systems.
- Gain experience explaining concepts to students, some of which who are not well-versed in computing.
- Reinforce material learned previously in class through continued use and teaching.
- Course material covers relational databases (EER diagrams, IFD, Normalization, SQL Queries).

positions.title: Computer Support Assistant
positions.description:
- Troubleshot and resolved problems that arose in School of Mathematics faculty computers and devices
- Performed basic hardware disassembly and set up software on new computers
- Frequently worked on command line and with Red Hat Enterprise Linux 6 and Windows 7

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description:
- Developed cross-platform mobile application of company’s primary product using HTML, CSS, Javascript, Angular.js, and AppGyver, a framework built on PhoneGap, resulting in up to 5000 mobile users
- Refactored products to support browser compatibility and re-implemented essential functionality
- Prototyped and benchmarked calendar applications for next iteration of the main product
- Gained experience in web development (Javascript, Bootstrap, jQuery, Angular.js)

positions.title: Research Intern
positions.description:
- Worked under supervision of Dr. Shawn R. Lockhart, Ph.D of the Mycotic Diseases Branch of NCEZID. 
- Conducted research on correlation between FKS mutations and increased MIC values of Candida spp. 
- Performed PCR, gel electrophoresis, DNA extraction, and used BioEdit, a biological sequence alignment editor.

company.name: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention

educations.fieldOfStudy: Business, and Technology Program, Korean Studies

projects.title: MedIT - Patient Appointment Application
projects.description: Collaborated with Dr. Donald Batisky of Children's Healthcare of Atlanta to develop a mobile, cross-platform patient appointment application to help patients arrive to appointments on-time. Allows patients to review upcoming appointment information and receive reminders and weather / traffic updates. Implemented with Ionic framework running on Apache Cordova (HTML, CSS, JS, Angular.js)

projects.title: College CS Ranking Information Visualization
projects.description: Web application visualizing college CS program rankings and data on interactive map of the US that includes interactive features such as filtering and details-on-demand using JavaScript and D3.js

organizations.name: GT Asian American Student Association
organizations.position: President, Vice President, Treasurer · Jan 2013 - Dec 2016
organizations.description: As President: I oversaw and provided the vision and direction of the organization's activities. I managed a board of officers and served as the final decision maker. As Vice President: I acted as liaison between the Asian-interest organizations on campus and promoted collaboration and communication among the participating organizations by building connections and relationships. As Treasurer, I kept track of the budget and managed funding, expenses, reimbursements, fundraising, and sponsorship.

organizations.name: GT China Care
organizations.description: China Care is a philanthropic organization that strives to assist Chinese orphans and adoptees. In GT China Care, volunteers hold Playgroups once a month to teach adoptees about Chinese culture and provide a community for support. Also, the organization collects fundraising money to contribute to the philanthropic efforts of the national organization.
